missions.name: First Contact
missions.brief: Hold the industrial district against three assault waves. Keep the reactor alive, then evacuate north.

missions.name: Lockdown
missions.brief: Checkpoint gates redirect the enemy assault. Four waves threaten the reactor. Buy upgrades before deployment.

missions.name: Last Light
missions.brief: The final defense. Five waves, heavier fire and new blast walls. Protect the reactor and bring your pilot home.
